name: wpcloud
description: Self-hosted WordPress, Nginx, PHP-FPM & Mail Manager for Ubuntu 24.04 VPS

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/agent/tsconfig.json && next build apps/panel --webpack
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@wpcloud/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@wpcloud/agent run typecheck && npm --workspace=@wpcloud/panel run typecheck
